scope: Accepted 1851-1855 batch-01 source-text rendering requirements; no converter/export/transcript changes. Extends prior addendum-10 with three concrete layered-source and MathML requirements.

requirements.case: MathML fractions in Royal Society vote
requirements.requirement: Preserve the MathML fraction structure in source-text rendering: <mfrac><mn>2</mn><mn>3</mn></mfrac> and <mfrac><mn>3</mn><mn>4</mn></mfrac> must remain fractions. Any plain-text fallback must be explicitly labelled as a rendering fallback and must not turn them into vote integers; the accepted flat body projection currently exposes raw 23 and 34.

source_provenance.locators: body paragraph 1; HTML MathML mfrac DOM

exact_source_evidence.quote: the defeat of my man, by 2/3 of the votes (it would have been by more than 3/4 had all voters been present)
exact_source_evidence.locator: body paragraph 1; HTML MathML mfrac DOM

exact_source_evidence.dom_locator: div#letter div.body-content; paragraph containing Royal Society vote

requirements.requirement: Render 1496 as an 1852 memorandum/questions document, retaining its eight numbered question blocks and separating the original query voice from Hooker pencil answers and later Darwin annotations/references. Do not serialize those layers as a normal Hooker letter or as a contemporary Darwin-Hooker answer exchange.

source_provenance.locators: body paragraphs 1–8; annotations and editorial footnotes

exact_source_evidence.quote: Cases of plants which must for ever self-fecundate themselves; do such occur?
exact_source_evidence.locator: body paragraphs 1–8; annotations and editorial footnotes

requirements.case: Receipt, dedication inspection and disjoint date candidates
requirements.requirement: Keep 1552F’s two mutually exclusive composition dates (9 or 16 February 1854) and render the sequence of receipt and partial inspection exactly: Darwin received the book, saw the dedication and some illustrations, had not read the title page or all illustrations, and intended to begin reading that evening. Do not import the 7 March and 23 March notebook entries as completed reading at receipt.

source_provenance.locators: body paragraph 1; header/date and editorial footnotes 1–2

exact_source_evidence.quote: I have within these few minutes received your Book, & after admiring some of the illustrations, I fell on the Dedication to me.—
exact_source_evidence.locator: body paragraph 1; header/date and editorial footnotes 1–2

implementation_boundary: Do not mutate frozen HTML/XML or body projections.
Do not normalize 23/34 into integer vote counts; retain MathML source and an explicit fallback representation.
Do not merge memorandum, annotation, enclosure or later notebook layers into a single author/date voice.
Do not import later publication or notebook reading dates into 1552F receipt state.
notes: 1539 MathML DOM was inspected directly: numerator/denominator pairs are 2 over 3 and 3 over 4.
1496 is a memorandum with Hooker pencil answers and later Darwin layers; these must remain visually and semantically distinct.
1552F’s 9-or-16-February date alternatives and partial inspection state are separate from later 7/23-March reading entries.
